name: Hydra, Ismenios
body:
Ismenios
CR 5

Multiple angry snake-like heads rise from the sleek, serpentine body of this terrifying monster.

XP 1,200
N Huge magical beast
Init +1; Senses all-around sight, darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 9, flat-footed 15 (+1 Dex, +7 natural, –2 size)
hp 57 (6d10+24); fast healing 6
Fort +9, Ref +8, Will +4
Defensive Abilities split (slashing, 9 hp)

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee 3 bites +8 (1d8+4)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks pounce, rend (3 bites, 1d8+6)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 12, Con 18, Int 2, Wis 11, Cha 9
Base Atk +6; CMB +12; CMD 23 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Combat Reflexes, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes
Skills Perception +11, Swim +11; Racial Modifiers +2 Perception

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Divided Mind (Ex)

Whenever an ismenios would have to make a Will save against an effect that targets a single creature, it can roll twice and use the better result.

Split (Ex)

When an ismenios hydra takes slashing damage, it splits into two identical copies of itself, each of which can act independently and has half of the original creature’s hit points.

After combat, the strongest remaining body of the ismenios devours and swallows the other bodies, restoring itself to full hit points. Unlike a normal hydra’s regenerating heads, acid and fire damage do not prevent an ismenios from splitting.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate marshes
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

Ismenios are three-headed serpents, lacking legs and with wholly snake-like lower bodies. They are also rare among their hydra kin in that their heads do not die and regrow, but rather the ismenios can split its entire body when cleaved with a blade, forming two entirely two monstrosities to devour their prey before conjoining back together to digest their victims.
